WHAT: SSH into Windows 11 ARM UTM VM from Mac via port forwarding
HOW:
  From Mac: `ssh ned@localhost -p 2222`
  Password: ned (set with `net user ned ned`)
  Key auth: Add Mac pubkey to C:\ProgramData\ssh\administrators_authorized_keys (NOT ~/.ssh/authorized_keys — admin override)
  Key write: `[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("C:\ProgramData\ssh\administrators_authorized_keys", "<pubkey>\n")`
  Fix permissions: `icacls C:\ProgramData\ssh\administrators_authorized_keys /inheritance:r /grant "SYSTEM:F" /grant "Administrators:F"`
UTM CONFIG:
  Network: NAT (QEMU), VM IP is 10.0.2.15 (not reachable from Mac directly)
  Port forward: Guest 10.0.2.15:22 → Host 127.0.0.1:2222
  Must fully STOP (not restart) VM for port forward changes to take effect
FIREWALL: Added rule 'SSH-Allow-All' for Profile=Any (default rule only covers Private)
GOTCHA: `Out-File` adds UTF8 BOM — use WriteAllText instead for authorized_keys
GOTCHA: SSH over NAT from non-interactive session can't create tray icons or hotkeys — run app from Windows desktop directly
